column1: # mapping_set_description: 'Maps each bridge concept in bom.ttl to the corresponding class, property or RelationshipType individual in the SPDX 3.1-dev model (spdx-model.ttl as of 2026-10-27, spdx-3-model commit 66029136). This is the pivot file enabling first-pass auto-generation of per-standard SPDX 3 crosswalks: a source-standard concept that carries skos:exactMatch or skos:closeMatch to a bridge concept inherits the SPDX 3.1 mapping via a transitive join with this file. Hand-curated per-standard files (cisa2026-to-spdx31, g7ai2026-to-spdx31, ntia2021-to-spdx31, ...) override individual rows for higher precision. Revised 2026-10-12 for SPDX 3.1-dev changes: Core/version on Bom, Tool and Package (packageVersion deprecated), Hardware profile, intendedUse, standardName, isoAutomationLevel, serializedInArtifact / amendedBy relationships, and RelationshipType individuals used as object_id with object_property relationshipType, object_class spdx3-core:Relationship and object_path ^spdx3-core:from. Revised 2026-10-28 for the 3.1-dev move of additionalInformation (DictionaryEntry key/value) from the Hardware profile to Core, where it is now on SoftwareArtifact, SoftwareService, Hardware, Action and DefinedProcess: GAP rows whose missing information is a short intrinsic value (criticality, structured flag, AI input / output modality, context length, parameter count, compute, openness category, dataset domain, data points, copyright status of the content, sensitive data category) gain a broadMatch row to Core/additionalInformation with a key convention that reuses the lowerCamelCase property names proposed in working-docs/spdx31-gap-analysis.md (parameterCount, contextLength, inputModality, ...); the existing fallback rows stay, as they are the SPDX 3.0.1 carriers.'

column8: comment

The BOM document corresponds to a Software/Sbom element (subclass of Core/Bom and Core/Bundle), the root collection of the SPDX graph; it carries CreationInfo and, in 3.1-dev, Bom.version and Sbom.sbomType. closeMatch: an SpdxDocument is the serialization-level collection; the Sbom is the content-level collection.
Generic components (packages, files, snippets, AI models, datasets, hardware, services) all subclass Core/Artifact. closeMatch at the abstract level.

Typed relationships between elements are first-class Core/Relationship elements with from, to (1..*), relationshipType (RelationshipType vocabulary) and optional completeness (complete, incomplete, noAssertion). The subclass LifecycleScopedRelationship adds scope (build, runtime, ...). Specific relationship kinds map to RelationshipType individuals (dependsOn, contains, trainedOn, ...).

Relationship.completeness (0..1, RelationshipCompleteness: complete, incomplete, noAssertion) states whether the listed to-elements are the full set; carries the BSI completeness indication and CISA coverage practice. closeMatch.
Software-specific components (Package, File, Snippet) subclass Software/SoftwareArtifact. closeMatch.
AI systems and models are represented as AI/AIPackage elements (subclass of Software/Package) in the SPDX AI profile. closeMatch.
Datasets are represented as Dataset/DatasetPackage elements (subclass of Software/Package) in the SPDX Dataset profile. closeMatch.

Infrastructure components (container images, ML frameworks, OS layers) are Software/Package elements linked by dependsOn relationships (LifecycleScopedRelationship scope = runtime or build); hardware accelerators are Hardware/Hardware elements reached via runsOn (3.1-dev Hardware profile). relatedMatch: no single SPDX class covers the full infrastructure concept.

Security concepts span several profiles: Security/Vulnerability plus VEX assessment relationships for vulnerability referencing; conformsTo relationships to Specification / Regulation elements and Artifact.standardName for compliance (AIPackage.standardCompliance is deprecated in 3.1); externalRef (securityPolicy, securityAdvisory, ...) and ContactPointRelationship for policies and contacts. relatedMatch.

CreationInfo.createdBy (1..*) references the Agent(s) -- Person, Organization or SoftwareAgent -- accountable for the document. Tools used belong in createdUsing, not here, which matches the CISA 2026 / G7 requirement to distinguish the author from the generating tool. Organization.headquartersLocation (3.1-dev) can add the author's country.

CreationInfo.created (1..1, Core/DateTime (UTC, second resolution), UTC) records when the element was created. Each SBOM revision is a new Sbom/SpdxDocument with its own CreationInfo, so 'most recent update' (CISA 2026, G7) is the created value of the current revision; link revisions with amendedBy.

Software/Sbom.sbomType (0..*, SbomType vocabulary: design, source, build, analyzed, deployed, runtime) states the lifecycle context and evidence used to generate the SBOM; multiple values allowed. closeMatch: value vocabularies differ across standards (CISA 2026 'before build' / 'build' / 'after build'). Do not use LifecycleScopedRelationship.scope for this: it scopes individual relationships, not the document.
ElementCollection.rootElement on the Sbom identifies the primary element(s) the collection describes (the SBOM's root subject). Exact match for the primary-component concept.
Alternative/complementary path: a Relationship with relationshipType describes from the Sbom to the primary Package. rootElement is preferred in SPDX 3.x.

SPDX 3.1-dev adds the Core/version property (0..1) to Core/Bom, inherited by Software/Sbom: a human-readable version of the SBOM itself, distinct from the spec version and from component versions. This closes the gap present in SPDX 3.0.1, where no SBOM-version field existed.

Revision lineage: a Relationship with relationshipType amendedBy from the previous Sbom/SpdxDocument to the new one makes the version sequence explicit, mirroring the SPDX 2.x AMENDS practice. Each revision also has its own immutable spdxId. Note: the RelationshipType vocabulary says the from Element is amended by each to Element (previous -> new), while the Bom class text says the Relationship goes from the updated BOM to the original; the model contradicts itself.

CreationInfo.specVersion (1..1) carries the SPDX specification version string (e.g. '3.1'). Exact match for the format-version aspect. The format name (SPDX) is implied by the model instance itself (JSON-LD @context IRI https://spdx.org/rdf/3.1/spdx-context.jsonld); there is no separate format-name field, so the format-name aspect is COMPOSED (specVersion + model identity).
CreationInfo.createdUsing (0..*) references Core/Tool elements; Element.name on the Tool carries the tool name. Exact match.

SPDX 3.1-dev adds Core/version (0..1) to Core/Tool, so the tool version is native. SPDX 3.0.1 has no Tool version property and needs a Tool -> versioned Package relationship (packagedBy / hasDistributionArtifact) or an ExternalIdentifier of type packageUrl carrying the version instead.

GAP (missing field): no SPDX version has a native author-signature property. Element.verifiedUsing + Hash on the Sbom/SpdxDocument proves integrity only, not authorship. Signatures are attached externally by wrapping the serialized document in an in-toto/DSSE attestation (SPDX is a registered in-toto attestation predicate type), CMS or JWS. narrowMatch; signature gap noted.

The serializedInArtifact relationship (3.1-dev) links the SpdxDocument to the Artifact holding its serialized form; that Artifact's verifiedUsing hash and an external signature over the exact bytes together bind the signature to the payload. relatedMatch.

Every Element, including the Sbom and SpdxDocument, is identified by its spdxId IRI (the JSON-LD @id), which must be globally unique and serves as the persistent document identifier (BSI BOM-URI; CISA 2026 immutable revision identifier). closeMatch: spdxId is the element IRI, not a dedicated property.

Element.name (0..1; 1..1 on Package) carries the human-readable component name on any Element subclass (Package, File, AIPackage, DatasetPackage, Hardware, ...). Exact match. GAP (cardinality): CISA 2026 and G7 ask for multiple entries for alternate names; name is single-valued (see spdx/spdx-3-model#1432); use externalIdentifier/externalRef for normalized identifiers.
SPDX 3.1-dev: Core/version (0..1) on Software/Package (also on Hardware, Tool, Bom, DefinedProcess) carries the component version string. Exact match.
Software/packageVersion is DEPRECATED in SPDX 3.1 in favour of Core/version; retained for SPDX 3.0.1 compatibility and when a pinned schema requires it.

Artifact.suppliedBy (0..1) identifies the Agent who supplied/distributed the artifact. Exact match for the distributing-party reading of 'supplier'. For the NTIA 'Supplier Name' field, which conflates supplier and originator, see also originatedBy via bom:component-producer.

Artifact.originatedBy (0..*) identifies the Agent from whom the artifact originally came -- the entity that creates, defines and identifies the component (CISA 2026 Component Producer; G7 System/Model producer). Exact match. suppliedBy is not a substitute unless the supplier also originated the component. Organization.headquartersLocation (3.1-dev) can carry the producer's country.

Software/Package.packageUrl (0..1, PURL / ECMA-427) is the recommended common identifier for packages, AI models (pkg:huggingface/...) and datasets. Exact match for the primary external-identifier use case.
ExternalIdentifier with externalIdentifierType cpe22 (identifier = the CPE 2.2 string). closeMatch (one identifier kind).
ExternalIdentifier with externalIdentifierType cpe23. closeMatch (one identifier kind).
ExternalIdentifier with externalIdentifierType swid (SWID tag id). closeMatch (one identifier kind).
ExternalIdentifier with externalIdentifierType swhid (Software Heritage persistent identifier). closeMatch (one identifier kind).
ExternalIdentifier with externalIdentifierType gitoid (OmniBOR artifact or input-manifest identifier). closeMatch (one identifier kind).

SoftwareArtifact.contentIdentifier (0..*) -> ContentIdentifier {contentIdentifierType: gitoid | swhid, contentIdentifierValue}: canonical intrinsic identifiers derived from content (OmniBOR gitoid, SWHID). closeMatch for the intrinsic-identifier subset.
The element's spdxId IRI is globally unique and may be used as an identifier within and across SPDX documents, but does not replace common external identifiers. closeMatch.

Artifact (Element).verifiedUsing (0..*) -> IntegrityMethod; a Core/Hash object holds the algorithm/hashValue pair. verifiedUsing is the entry point; the two data fields are mapped separately below. closeMatch at property level.
Hash.hashValue (1..1, hexadecimal string) is the digest -- CISA 2026 'Component Hash Value', G7 'Model hash value'. narrowMatch (one aspect of the algorithm + digest pair).

Hash.algorithm (1..1, HashAlgorithm vocabulary: sha256, sha512, sha3_256, blake2b512, blake3, md5, ...) -- CISA 2026 'Component Hash Algorithm', G7 'Model hash algorithm'. narrowMatch (the algorithm aspect); value vocabulary is SPDX's own, not IANA textual names (deterministic mapping exists).

Relationship with relationshipType hasDeclaredLicense from the Artifact to an AnyLicenseInfo element (LicenseExpression, ListedLicense, CustomLicense, NoAssertionLicense, NoneLicense). Exact match following the SPDX implementation paper. Note the 3.1-dev model text: hasDeclaredLicense = the Artifact 'was discovered to actually contain' the license info (e.g. as detected by tooling); hasConcludedLicense = the license the SPDX data creator concludes governs the Artifact. A statement of the license under which a component is available fits either; when both are given and differ, explain in comment.
Relationship with relationshipType hasConcludedLicense: the license the SPDX data creator concludes governs the Artifact. Equally valid carrier of a governing-license statement; closeMatch.

SimpleLicensing/LicenseExpression.licenseExpression (1..1) carries the SPDX license expression string (license identifiers), the machine-processable form CISA 2026 asks for; licenseListVersion pins the list. closeMatch (value-level field inside the license relationship target).
ExternalRef with externalRefType license links the licence text when it is not an SPDX LicenseExpression. closeMatch.

Relationship with relationshipType hasDeclaredLicense from the Artifact to an AnyLicenseInfo element (LicenseExpression, ListedLicense, CustomLicense, NoAssertionLicense, NoneLicense): the license the Artifact was discovered to contain or declare, i.e. the upstream statement. Exact match.

SimpleLicensing/LicenseExpression.licenseExpression (1..1) on the element reached through the hasDeclaredLicense Relationship carries the declared SPDX license expression string. closeMatch (value field of the relationship target).
ExternalRef with externalRefType license links the declared licence text when it is not an SPDX LicenseExpression. closeMatch.
Relationship with relationshipType hasConcludedLicense from the Artifact to an AnyLicenseInfo element: the license the SPDX data creator concludes governs the Artifact after analysis. Exact match.

SimpleLicensing/LicenseExpression.licenseExpression (1..1) on the element reached through the hasConcludedLicense Relationship carries the concluded SPDX license expression string. closeMatch (value field of the relationship target).
Software/SoftwareArtifact.copyrightText (0..1) carries the copyright notice for Package, File and Snippet. closeMatch: no copyright field on non-software elements.
Artifact.releaseTime (0..1) is the formal release date of a component. Primary match for released packages and model release dates. Together with builtTime covers the component-timestamp concept.
Artifact.builtTime (0..1) is the build/training completion time. Primary match for AI model training timestamps and built artifacts. validUntilTime covers end-of-validity.
Element.description (0..1) provides a free-text description for any component type; Element.summary (0..1) holds a short form. Exact match.

Element.externalRef (0..*) -> ExternalRef {externalRefType, locator, contentType, comment}. ExternalRefType covers documentation, vcs, altWebPage, altDownloadLocation, bom, securityAdvisory, securityPolicy, metrics, releaseNotes, productMetadata, certificationReport and more. exactMatch: the generic external-reference concept; covers many reference categories via the typed sub-field.
Software/Package.homePage (0..1) is the component's web page; ExternalRef of type altWebPage is the general alternative. closeMatch.

ExternalRef with externalRefType vcs (locator = repository URL, optionally with a tag or commit) points to the source repository; SoftwareArtifact.downloadLocation / sourceInfo complement it. closeMatch.
ExternalRef with externalRefType documentation links the instructions for use; a Relationship with relationshipType hasDocumentation to a File is the bundled form. closeMatch.

SoftwareArtifact.downloadLocation (0..1) gives the location from which the artifact can be obtained; ExternalRef altDownloadLocation adds further channels. closeMatch: the channel type and level of access (weights vs black-box API) have no native field (GAP).

Relationship with relationshipType availableFrom links the component to the Agent(s) it is available from; hasDistributionArtifact links a Package to its distributed artifacts (archives, images). closeMatch.

Element.name on the Software/File element that represents the deployed file carries the filename itself; the File element is linked from the Package by hasDistributionArtifact or contains. closeMatch (requires creating the File element).
SoftwareArtifact.additionalPurpose (0..*) = executable when the executable nature is not the primary purpose. closeMatch.

SoftwareArtifact.primaryPurpose = executable (SoftwarePurpose). closeMatch: a purpose is not the structural flag (a shared library is executable but has purpose library); see GAP-12 for the proposed isExecutable.
SoftwareArtifact.additionalPurpose (0..*) = archive when the archive nature is not the primary purpose. closeMatch.

SoftwareArtifact.primaryPurpose = archive (SoftwarePurpose). closeMatch: a purpose is not the structural flag (a container image is an archive but has purpose container); see GAP-12 for the proposed isArchive.
primaryPurpose = container for a container image that bundles sub-components. closeMatch.
additionalPurpose = archive when the structured-archive nature is secondary. closeMatch.
additionalPurpose = container when the structured-archive nature is secondary. closeMatch.

GAP (missing field): no structured-archive flag. primaryPurpose = archive is a structured archive whose internal component metadata is recoverable, as opposed to firmware or executable blobs. closeMatch.
GAP (missing field): primaryPurpose = container (image) is likewise a structured archive. closeMatch.

GAP (missing field): no structured-archive flag. Core/additionalInformation (0..*, DictionaryEntry key/value; on SoftwareArtifact and so on Package, AIPackage and DatasetPackage since the 2026-10 3.1-dev model, also on SoftwareService, Hardware, Action and DefinedProcess) is the structured carrier for an intrinsic characteristic that has no dedicated property. Record it under the key 'isStructured' with value 'true' or 'false' (the flag of the BSI CycloneDX property bsi:component:structured). additionalInformationSpecification can name the Specification that defines the key. States the flag explicitly where primaryPurpose / additionalPurpose archive or container does not apply. broadMatch (container fallback; key convention only, not standardised). No SPDX 3.0.1 counterpart.
Code components are SoftwareArtifact elements (Package or File) with primaryPurpose source, linked via contains or generates relationships. closeMatch.
Documentation published outside the SBOM: Element.externalRef -> ExternalRef with externalRefType documentation and locator = URL. closeMatch (one reference type inside the generic array).
Documentation bundled as an element: a Relationship with relationshipType hasDocumentation from the component to the File or Package that is the document. closeMatch.
The bundled document itself is a SoftwareArtifact whose primaryPurpose is documentation, reached through the hasDocumentation Relationship. closeMatch.

Artifact.originatedBy identifies the originating Agent; Organization.headquartersLocation -> PhysicalLocation.country (3.1-dev) carries the country of origin. closeMatch: open-source vs proprietary classification is carried by the license, not a dedicated field.

Security profile VEX relationships (VexFixed / VexAffected / VexNotAffected / VexUnderInvestigation) state remediation status per vulnerability; patchedBy / fixedIn relationship types link to the fixing release. closeMatch.

Artifact.validUntilTime (0..1) specifies until when the artifact can be used before reassessment; Artifact.supportLevel (SupportType: support, limitedSupport, endOfSupport, noSupport, deployed, development) states the support status; ExternalRef eolNotice links the EOL announcement. closeMatch.

A SupportRelationship (relationshipType providesSupportFor, from = the supporting Agent, supportLevel SupportType, startTime and endTime mandatory) carries the end-of-support date as endTime with supportLevel endOfSupport. closeMatch.
SupportRelationship.supportLevel = endOfSupport marks the relationship as the end-of-support statement. closeMatch.
SupportRelationship.endTime (1..1 on this class) is the date the support ends. closeMatch.

GAP (missing field): no criticality level property in SPDX 3.1-dev. Element.comment or a CdxPropertiesExtension can carry it; Security profile CVSS/SSVC assessment relationships carry vulnerability-level severity only. broadMatch (container fallback).

GAP (missing field): no criticality level property. Core/additionalInformation (0..*, DictionaryEntry key/value; on SoftwareArtifact and so on Package, AIPackage and DatasetPackage since the 2026-10 3.1-dev model, also on SoftwareService, Hardware, Action and DefinedProcess) is the structured carrier for an intrinsic characteristic that has no dedicated property. Record it under the key 'criticality' with the level as value (on the SoftwareArtifact, SoftwareService or Hardware). additionalInformationSpecification can name the Specification that defines the key. Preferred over the Element.comment row: the model guidance reserves comment for remarks from an external party and additionalInformation for characteristics of the artifact itself. broadMatch (container fallback; key convention only, not standardised). No SPDX 3.0.1 counterpart.

Artifact.intendedUse (0..1, 3.1-dev) may state the boundaries of appropriate use, but contractual restrictions and acceptable-use policies are carried by the declared licence (hasDeclaredLicense to a CustomLicense / CustomLicenseAddition) or an ExternalRef of type license. relatedMatch.
ExternalRef with externalRefType license links the acceptable-use policy or licence terms that carry the restrictions. closeMatch.
Element.comment (0..1) carries free-text notes on any element. Exact match.

AIPackage.energyConsumption -> EnergyConsumption (trainingEnergyConsumption, finetuningEnergyConsumption, inferenceEnergyConsumption -> EnergyConsumptionDescription energyQuantity + energyUnit). GAP (missing field): carbon footprint and resource use have no field. closeMatch (energy only).

An instance of Core/Relationship whose relationshipType is dependsOn: from = the dependent element, to = the dependencies. Direction matters. LifecycleScopedRelationship is mandatory for this type (dependsOn_type constraint); its scope (build, runtime, test, ...) can qualify the dependency; completeness states whether the list is complete. Related types: hasOptionalDependency, hasProvidedDependency, hasPrerequisite, hasStaticLink, hasDynamicLink.
Relationship with relationshipType contains: from = the container (system, package, archive), to = the contained elements. Exact match.
Relationship with relationshipType trainedOn from the AIPackage to the DatasetPackage(s). Finer types in 3.1-dev: pretrainedOn, finetunedOn, testedOn, validatedOn, evaluatedOn.

Relationship with relationshipType descendantOf: the from Element (derived component, fine-tuned or distilled model, derived dataset) is a descendant of each to Element (its predecessor). Covers CISA 2026 MD-010, G7 MDL-006 and DP-009 lineage.

Relationship with relationshipType ancestorOf is the inverse reading (the from Element is an ancestor of each to Element) and expresses known derivative models of a base model. closeMatch because the bridge concept is directed from the derived component.
AI/AIPackage.domain (0..*, string) enumerates the application domains for which the AI package is intended. closeMatch: AI/domain mixes technical domain and sector (spdx/spdx-3-model#659).
Artifact.intendedUse (0..1, 3.1-dev) is the provider-declared intended use (bom:ai-intended-use), not the sector; a sector is usually named inside it. relatedMatch.

Core/Artifact.intendedUse (0..1, string, 3.1-dev; inherited by AIPackage, Package and DatasetPackage): a statement of how or for what purpose the artifact is intended to be used, outlining the scope and boundaries of appropriate or intended applications. Same provider-declared sense as EU AI Act Art. 3(12) intended purpose. Exact match.
AI/AIPackage.domain (0..*, string) names the domain in which the model can be expected to operate; the sector half of an intended-use statement. relatedMatch.

AI/AIPackage.limitation (0..1, string) captures limitations and contexts in which the package should not be used; informationAboutApplication adds detail. closeMatch: restricted / prohibited uses have no dedicated field.

Artifact.intendedUse (0..1, 3.1-dev) states the intended applications, not what the model can technically do (DPV separates capability from intended use); capability has no SPDX field beyond Element.summary / description. relatedMatch.
AI/AIPackage.domain (0..*, string) records the application domain(s) the model is designed for; covers the application-area half of capability. relatedMatch.
Element.summary (0..1) is the short description of the AIPackage and can state its capabilities. closeMatch (free text, no structured task list).
AI/AIPackage.limitation (0..1, string) records known limitations of the AI package, e.g. poor accuracy for a certain demography. exactMatch.

GAP (missing field): no structured data-flow field. AI/AIPackage.informationAboutApplication (free text) is the closest container; relationships (hasInput, hasOutput, usesTool) can model component-level flows. broadMatch (container fallback).

AI/AIPackage.useSensitivePersonalInformation (0..1, PresenceType: yes, no, noAssertion) covers the sensitive-data aspect; informationAboutApplication covers the broader data-usage narrative. closeMatch.

GAP (missing field): no structured input/output schema or modality field. informationAboutApplication (free text) and typeOfModel partially cover it; AI/InteractionTemplate (3.1-dev) describes prompt structure and placeholders. broadMatch (container fallback).

AI/InteractionTemplate (3.1-dev, Artifact subclass) defines the structure, formatting and variable placeholders for model interactions -- a partial, prompt-level description of the input interface. relatedMatch.

GAP (missing field): no structured input modality field in SPDX 3.1-dev. informationAboutApplication (free text) can state the accepted input modalities and size limits. broadMatch (container fallback).

GAP (missing field): no structured input modality field. Core/additionalInformation (0..*, DictionaryEntry key/value; on SoftwareArtifact and so on Package, AIPackage and DatasetPackage since the 2026-10 3.1-dev model, also on SoftwareService, Hardware, Action and DefinedProcess) is the structured carrier for an intrinsic characteristic that has no dedicated property. Record it under the key 'inputModality' with a comma-separated list such as 'text,image'. additionalInformationSpecification can name the Specification that defines the key. Preferred over the free-text informationAboutApplication row. broadMatch (container fallback; key convention only, not standardised). No SPDX 3.0.1 counterpart.

GAP (missing field): no structured output modality field in SPDX 3.1-dev. informationAboutApplication (free text) can state the produced output modalities and size limits. broadMatch (container fallback).

GAP (missing field): no structured output modality field. Core/additionalInformation (0..*, DictionaryEntry key/value; on SoftwareArtifact and so on Package, AIPackage and DatasetPackage since the 2026-10 3.1-dev model, also on SoftwareService, Hardware, Action and DefinedProcess) is the structured carrier for an intrinsic characteristic that has no dedicated property. Record it under the key 'outputModality' with a comma-separated list such as 'text'. additionalInformationSpecification can name the Specification that defines the key. Preferred over the free-text informationAboutApplication row. broadMatch (container fallback; key convention only, not standardised). No SPDX 3.0.1 counterpart.

GAP (missing field): no dedicated context-length field. AI/AIPackage.hyperparameter (DictionaryEntry key/value) can carry it under a convention key such as contextLength. broadMatch (container fallback).

GAP (missing field): no dedicated context-length field. Core/additionalInformation (0..*, DictionaryEntry key/value; on SoftwareArtifact and so on Package, AIPackage and DatasetPackage since the 2026-10 3.1-dev model, also on SoftwareService, Hardware, Action and DefinedProcess) is the structured carrier for an intrinsic characteristic that has no dedicated property. Record it under the key 'contextLength' with the token count as value. additionalInformationSpecification can name the Specification that defines the key. Preferred over the hyperparameter row: hyperparameter is defined as settings fixed before training, which does not cover an inference-time limit. broadMatch (container fallback; key convention only, not standardised). No SPDX 3.0.1 counterpart.

AI/AIPackage.informationAboutApplication (free text) explicitly covers pre-processing steps applied to input data before inference, such as data cleaning, normalization or feature extraction. closeMatch; there is no structured tokenizer field.
AI/InteractionTemplate (3.1-dev) defines the structure and placeholders of prompts; covers prompt templates. A tokenizer can additionally be a separate Package linked by dependsOn. relatedMatch.

Basket concept distributed across AIPackage properties: typeOfModel, modelExplainability, isoAutomationLevel (Core, 3.1-dev; autonomyType is deprecated), safetyRiskAssessment, limitation, hyperparameter, metric, metricDecisionThreshold, energyConsumption. broadMatch at class level.
AI/AIPackage.typeOfModel (0..*, string) records the model type / architecture (e.g. transformer, decoder-only, CNN). closeMatch for the architecture sub-aspect.
AI/AIPackage.hyperparameter (0..*, DictionaryEntry key/value) records model hyper-parameters. closeMatch for the hyper-parameter sub-aspect.

AI/AIPackage.isoAutomationLevel (0..1, 3.1-dev, IsoAutomationLevel: notAutomated ... autonomous) records (AIPackage.autonomyType, PresenceType, is DEPRECATED in 3.1) the autonomy / level of automation -- the element the G7 group discussed but did not add. closeMatch.

GAP (missing field): no parameter-count field in SPDX 3.1-dev. The count can be stated in typeOfModel or hyperparameter (key 'parameterCount'); SoftwareArtifact.byteSize gives the storage size of the weights file, not the parameter count. broadMatch (container fallback).
GAP (missing field): the parameter count can be carried as an AI/AIPackage.hyperparameter DictionaryEntry under a convention key such as 'parameterCount'. broadMatch (container fallback).
SoftwareArtifact.byteSize (0..1) gives the size in bytes of the distributed weights, not the parameter count. relatedMatch.

GAP (missing field): no parameter-count field. Core/additionalInformation (0..*, DictionaryEntry key/value; on SoftwareArtifact and so on Package, AIPackage and DatasetPackage since the 2026-10 3.1-dev model, also on SoftwareService, Hardware, Action and DefinedProcess) is the structured carrier for an intrinsic characteristic that has no dedicated property. Record it under the key 'parameterCount' with an integer or scientific notation such as '7.3e10'. additionalInformationSpecification can name the Specification that defines the key. Preferred over the hyperparameter row: hyperparameter by definition excludes the learned parameters (GAP-47). broadMatch (container fallback; key convention only, not standardised). No SPDX 3.0.1 counterpart.

AI/AIPackage.typeOfModel (0..*, string) is free text recording the type of model; its definition cites supervised, unsupervised and reinforcement-learning models. There is no parametric vs non-parametric vocabulary. closeMatch.

GAP (missing field): no architecture field distinct from the free-text typeOfModel. Architecture family, network type and named architecture can only be stated as text in typeOfModel. broadMatch: typeOfModel is a broader free text.
AI/AIPackage.hyperparameter (0..*, DictionaryEntry key/value) records hyper-parameters of the model and of its training. exactMatch.

AI/AIPackage.informationAboutTraining (0..1, free text) describes the training process; together with hyperparameter, modelDataPreprocessing and the pretrainedOn / finetunedOn / trainedOn relationships it covers training properties. closeMatch.
AI/AIPackage.modelDataPreprocessing (0..*, string) describes preprocessing steps applied to training data. closeMatch for the preprocessing sub-aspect.
Relationships with relationshipType pretrainedOn / finetunedOn / trainedOn link the model to the datasets of each training stage, making the training lineage explicit. closeMatch.

A Relationship with relationshipType trainedOn (also pretrainedOn, finetunedOn, validatedOn, testedOn) from the AIPackage to each DatasetPackage records the training-data side of the training characteristics. closeMatch.
AI/AIPackage.typeOfModel (free text) is defined with the examples supervised, unsupervised and reinforcement-learning model; it records the learning paradigm only informally. closeMatch.
AI/AIPackage.informationAboutTraining (free text) describes the training algorithms and techniques employed, including the learning paradigm. closeMatch.

GAP (missing field): no structured post-training field in SPDX 3.1-dev. informationAboutTraining (free text) covers fine-tuning and transfer learning; the finetunedOn relationship identifies the fine-tuning dataset and descendantOf the base model. broadMatch (container fallback).

GAP (missing field): no field for the amount of computation (FLOP) used for training or inference. informationAboutTraining (free text) can state it informally, together with the methodology; hyperparameter does not fit (it holds settings fixed before training, not a measured amount). broadMatch (container fallback).

Training duration: model a training run as a Build/Build element (Core/startTime, Core/endTime, buildType, environment, parameter; buildStartTime / buildEndTime are DEPRECATED in 3.1) linked to the AIPackage by a generates relationship; wall-clock duration follows from the two timestamps. Hardware-days have no field. closeMatch for the training-time sub-aspect.

GAP (missing field): no field for the amount of computation (FLOP). Core/additionalInformation (0..*, DictionaryEntry key/value; on SoftwareArtifact and so on Package, AIPackage and DatasetPackage since the 2026-10 3.1-dev model, also on SoftwareService, Hardware, Action and DefinedProcess) is the structured carrier for an intrinsic characteristic that has no dedicated property. Record it under the key 'trainingCompute' or 'inferenceCompute' with the FLOP count such as '2.4e25'. additionalInformationSpecification can name the Specification that defines the key. Preferred over the free-text informationAboutTraining row for the number itself; the methodology stays in informationAboutTraining. broadMatch (container fallback; key convention only, not standardised). No SPDX 3.0.1 counterpart.
AI/AIPackage.metric (0..*, DictionaryEntry) and metricDecisionThreshold carry accuracy, F1, latency, throughput and similar KPIs; energyConsumption covers energy KPIs. closeMatch.
